senses.gloss: (חִ׳) הִידֵּס (cmp. דחס) to make incisions, mark (cmp. הנדז) esp. (of chickens) to leave marks of the feet, to scratch.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 2:2">B. Kam. II, 2</cite> <he>היה מְהַדֵּס וכ׳</he> it was scratching and broke vessels; expl.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 17b">ib. 17ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הי׳ והתיז</he> it scratched and caused the smashing of the vessel by rolling it against a hard object.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 17b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>היו מְהַדְּסִין על וכ׳</he> left marks on dough or fruits, or soiled &c.; Y. ib. II, beg. 2ᵈ <he>שהידסו את וכ׳</he>.
ib. l. c. העלו עפר) they threw dust by scratching; a. e. [Ar. reads חדס; Syr. הדס to study.]
